summary.description: BAK identifies N21700CX-65E as a 21700 cell with 6350mAh rated capacity, 6500mAh typical capacity, and a 19050mA maximum discharge in its Version A/00 specification. Battery Mooch tested the exact model and estimated about 20A true continuous current; the safer runtime recommendation is 19A, while the 25.4A/4C figures remain higher manufacturer or temperature-limited context.
highlights: Exact model identity is supported by BAK documentation and an exact-model vaping test.
The recommended runtime value is 6500mAh and 19A continuous; the manufacturer datasheet lists 6350mAh rated capacity and 19.05A maximum discharge.
Mooch's exact-sample estimate is about 20A, while the 25.4A/4C figures are not used as the conservative runtime value.
The tested cells lacked CCC marks and may be pre-production; production continuity remains unresolved.
Catalog fit was confirmed before admission; the runtime preset is battery-86.
Runtime admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.

claims.statement: BAK's exact model is N21700CX-65E, marketed as the BAK 21700-65E or 65E.
The Version A/00 datasheet lists 6350mAh rated capacity and 6500mAh typical capacity for the exact N21700CX-65E 21700 cell.
The manufacturer datasheet gives 19050mA maximum discharge, while Battery Mooch estimated about 20A true continuous current from the exact tested samples.
For a conservative Steam Engine runtime profile, use 19A continuous and 6500mAh typical capacity; retain 6350mAh rated capacity and the approximately 20A test estimate as supporting context.
The exact BAK 21700-65E has an eligible exact-model vaping battery test.
DIY500AMP currently lists the exact BAK 65E as a limited-quantity new arrival, providing current cross-market availability evidence.
BAK publicly announced the N21700CX-65E on January 8, 2026 for industrial and robotics applications.
The current Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact BAK 21700-65E preset.
